Subject: Startup sandbox credits for Greenline cohort

Hi Tessa / Ben,

We're kicking off a new cohort on June 7th and Greenline is looking for a reliable sandbox offer we can point founders to. Historically we've linked startups to a handful of partners; your platform comes up often for inference quality and cost. A few quick questions you can help with: 

- What is the usual accelerator sandbox credit amount and expiry window?
- Can credits be applied to production traffic if the company graduates early, or are they strictly for dev/staging?
- Is there flexibility for a top-up or extension for standout companies?
- Any procurement or SOW requirements we should anticipate for cohort-wide offers?

We have ~18 companies expected in the first cohort; average expected_token_use/month is rough — anywhere from 200k to 2M tokens depending on the app. Attaching the cohort list for context.

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if that's easier. Looking to finalize partner offers by May 27.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Doe
Program Director, Greenline Ventures

Hi Sam — great to hear from you and congrats on the cohort. Quick answers then an option set: 

Typical defaults (self-serve accelerator offering):
- Credit amount: $5,000 USD per company
- Validity: 90 days from issuance
- Scope: Intended for dev/staging; we allow up to 20% of credits to be used for low-throughput early prod if teams declare the use case and we flag for support/observability.

Custom option (what I think will fit Greenline):
- Tiered sandbox: $7,000 credit for each company in the first 20 companies
- Baseline expiry: 90 days, with a performance-triggered 6-month extension for up to 5 top performers (see triggers below)
- Triggers for extension: (a) Monthly active tokens >= 500k for any 2 months during the initial 90-day window; (b) integration milestone: successful deployment behind customer-managed routing or evidence of production test harness.

We can structure the above as either a partner promo (self-serve codes for each company) or as an invoiced SOW if Greenline wants consolidated billing/assignment. The latter requires finance/legal sign-off and a minimum commit (options below).

To move fast I attached a quick draft credit structure (spreadsheet) so we can iterate. If you want Ben/Monica to loop in finance/legal for the SOW path, say the word and I'll set up a follow-up.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | redwood.ai

Tessa/Monica — quick thoughts from pricing: 

If Greenline is driving cohort volume, we should lean into a hybrid: credits for immediate traction + a graded post-credit discount to convert trials to paid. Proposal: 
- Sandbox credits: $7k for first 20 companies as you suggested.
- Post-credit conversion: 30% list discount for the first 6 months after credits are exhausted or expire (whichever comes first).
- Referral/top-up incentive: if a company refers another Greenline portfolio company within 6 months, we top up $1k credits to both.

Operational notes: discounts for invoiced customers require a documented deal (SOW + purchase order). I'd flag DEAL-GLV-2027-01 as a potential umbrella SOW if Greenline wants consolidated bill-to. Monica, any finance/credit caveats?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Startup sandbox credits for Greenline cohort

Ben/Tessa — FYI from finance/legal perspective: 

- Self-serve promo codes: easiest. No SOW, no invoicing, credits issued to company email on sign-up. Finance can track redemptions but we cannot guarantee assignment for consolidated cohorts.
- Invoiced SOW path: requires minimums. Finance's standard is a 12-month minimum revenue commitment for any contract that creates an invoiced discount or customized credit pool. We can offer a convertible approach as a compromise: issue cohort credits up-front for 90 days; any unused credits at expiry can be converted into a 60-day extension OR a one-time 30% off coupon valid for first invoice within 45 days of expiry. This reduces financial exposure but gives the cohort flexibility.
- Legal: we need partner attribution language in the SOW if Greenline wants co-marketing rights.

I'll attach the finance guidelines and can draft a short clause for the SOW. For the invoiced SOW option, we'll need a primary contact and billing entity for Greenline.

Monica Patel
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Sam — summary and next steps below. Thanks again for the patience while we pulled finance/legal guidance.

Recommended partner offer (fast path — self-serve):
- 20 company cohort: $7,000 sandbox credit per company, valid 90 days from issuance.
- Use case: primarily dev/staging; up to 20% allowance for early low-throughput prod if teams document usage.
- Top-performer extension: up to 5 companies can receive a 6-month extension if they meet either trigger (500k MAU tokens for 2 months within initial 90 days OR successful integration milestone).

Alternative (consolidated SOW path, slower but consolidated billing):
- Cohort-level SOW under DEAL-GLV-2027-01 with a minimum 12-month commitment (standard finance ask).
- We can structure a convertible-credit clause: unused credits convert to a 60-day extension OR a one-time 30% invoice coupon (your choice).

Referral bonus: $1k top-ups for both referrer and referee if a company referral happens within 6 months of sign-up.

Attachments: I put a short SOW draft here for your review: https://redwood.drive/s/1a2b3c/sow-greenline-draft (also attached to this thread).

If this matches your expectations, please confirm by May 27 and advise whether you prefer self-serve codes or a consolidated SOW (and if SOW, who is the billing contact). Happy to hop on a call next week to finalize wording.

Best,
